title: SKELL: Sketch Engine for Language Learning Academic Collocation Database

features.word_sketch: Syntactic collocation matrix showing nouns that act as subjects or objects of a verb, modifiers of a noun, and prepositional patterns.
features.similar_words: Distributional semantic thesaurus identifying words used in identical linguistic environments.
features.examples: Clean, authentic corpus sentences culled from billions of words of vetted web texts.
